latestTerminalSummary:
Completed [T333E107’s full author proof](/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-14/fresh-analytic-discovery-r107/proof.md): every closed smooth orientable surface with every smooth Riemannian metric admits a smooth isometric embedding into exactly \(\mathbb R^4\), using the stipulated source333 operations.

The bridge is an oblique tubular projection that removes the oscillatory derivative and preserves injectivity through every finite step. The frozen scope is unchanged.

**No acceptance credit claimed.** Independent proof and contribution gates remain pending. The [operation comparison](/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-14/fresh-analytic-discovery-r107/operation-comparison.md) documents a serious technical-corollary risk: the source supplies all analytic machinery, while embedding preservation has classical antecedents.

The [handoff](/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-14/fresh-analytic-discovery-r107/README.md) includes hostile checks, reading limits, provenance and a read-only verifier. Final integrity verification covered 34 payloads, 26 external anchors and 13 pinned blobs. Seven tampering controls rejected correctly. No publication or shared-file changes occurred.
